messages:
josh_support: Escalation SUP-6120 from onboarding: Novus Therapeutics onboarding blocked. Several admins hit 403 when exchanging SAML assertion -> token. Theyre mid-onboarding and have a renewal discussion in ~26 days. Need CS + AE comms plan. Error: 'ExchangeTokenFailed' in logs.

josh_support: Repro in ticket: SP-initiated SSO -> SAML assertion accepted -> POST /auth/exchange returns 403 for some accounts. First seen 2024-09-10T15:07:02Z, recurring intermittently. Attached logs/screenshots.

amara_cs: Taking CSM lead. Can AE confirm scope (admins vs end-users)? I'll draft a short customer update to send within 1 hour.

carmen_ae: On the kickoff call now. Affects their setup/admin cohort (~8 users) blocking the final steps. Sponsor is sensitive because of go-live timeline. I'll join triage and message their exec sponsor.

sophia_se: I can run a guided repro with one of their admins. Quick checks: browser cookies, incognito, clock skew, and verify original SAML audience. Sometimes a metadata rotation causes mismatch.

ryan_infra: I see a small spike in 403s from auth-proxy for tenant=novus around 15:00 UTC. No deploys at that time. I can enable tenant-level routing to an alternate token-service instance (cache-bypass) as a low-risk mitigation. Need CS/AE approval to toggle.

amara_cs: Approve mitigation toggle. Draft comms plan: 1) immediate: enable mitigation + send 1-hr status to customer; 2) short term: 30m repro + enablement call today; 3) follow-up: RCA and permanent fix ETA within 48 hrs; 4) renewal touch: AE to reassure sponsor and loop sales if terms become a concern.

status_bot: [action] tenant-token-bypass=enabled for tenant=novus-therapeutics by ryan_infra at 2024-09-10T15:34:10Z

josh_support: Customer confirmed one previously failing admin could complete setup after the mitigation. Updating SUP-6120.

sophia_se: On call captured token-service response for failed exchanges: {"error":"invalid_client","detail":"assertion_client_mismatch"} for a subset of assertions. Posting to ticket.

amara_cs: Action items:
- amara_cs: send 1-hr status update + meeting invite (30m repro)
- ryan_infra: keep mitigation toggled and create JIRA for permanent patch
- sophia_se: run enablement/repro session and document exact repro steps
- carmen_ae: send renewal reassurance to sponsor; escalate to sales if contract issues arise
- josh_support: consolidate logs/screenshots in SUP-6120 and mark P1->escalated-to-cs

ryan_infra: Monitoring shows errors dropped for the tenant after toggle. Will open JIRA and link SUP-6120.

amara_cs: Sent customer update at 08:40 PT (copy added to ticket). Will post RCA link when available. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
